why: Serves origin-absolute requests instead of refusing them, which turns this check back into the root serve every other browser tool here already does. A build whose `base` stopped being relative asks for /assets/... and would then be answered, so the one deployment shape GitHub Pages actually uses would pass while broken. Observed live: rewriting index.html's three "./assets/" references to "/assets/" makes the real check fail with "the app did not boot under /tanks/" and both 404s named -- that failure is what this mutation deletes.
killedBy: stripPrefix: the deploy shape REFUSES an origin-absolute asset path, which is the whole point of the prefix
stripPrefix: the deploy shape is not fooled by a sibling path that merely starts like the prefix
